back: Despite harmonisation, national financial statements were not comparable. Since 2005 the IFRS Regulation makes IFRS mandatory for the CONSOLIDATED statements of LISTED companies. Individual statements: local GAAP (France) or optional IFRS depending on the country.
The IASB – a private standard setter. Adopted by local regulators in > 140 jurisdictions (not the USA). IFRS = IAS (old, before 2001) + IFRS (since 2001) + SIC + IFRIC interpretations.
Provide decision-useful information to existing and potential investors, lenders and other creditors.
Fundamental: relevance (incl. materiality), faithful representation (incl. substance over form). Enhancing: comparability, verifiability, timeliness, understandability. Constraint: cost.
Individual IFRS/IAS (+ IFRIC/SIC) override the Conceptual Framework. The Framework is used when no standard applies.

front: Complete set of IFRS financial statements (IAS 1)
back: Balance sheet · statement of comprehensive income · cash flow statement (IAS 7) · statement of changes in equity · notes. Listed: + segment reporting (IFRS 8), EPS (IAS 33).

Current asset: realised/sold/consumed within 12 months OR within the operating cycle, or held for trading. Current liability: settled within 12 months or the operating cycle. No mandatory order of presentation.
Nature: raw materials, staff costs, depreciation… Function: cost of sales, selling & distribution, administrative. Choice under IAS 1.99; function method requires nature disclosures in the notes.
Gains/losses recognised outside P/L (e.g. some fair value changes, actuarial gains/losses, currency translation). Total comprehensive income = net income + OCI. OCI does not affect net income/EPS.
Prohibited under IFRS (IAS 1.87). A line 'extraordinary items' signals a non-IFRS statement.
Operating (direct or indirect method) · investing (non-current assets) · financing (debt, owners). Indirect method: net income + non-cash expenses ± changes in working capital.
For each equity component: profit or loss, OCI, transactions with owners (share issues, dividends, treasury shares, changes in ownership of subsidiaries), effects of IAS 8 restatements.

Replaces IAS 1. Defined subtotals in the income statement (operating profit…), categories operating/investing/financing, disclosure and reconciliation of management-defined performance measures (MPMs), aggregation principles.
